integration_backends.native_fit: mixOmics::block.spls(mode = 'regression', Y = n x 1 response, design explicit, keepX per predictor block, keepY = 1)
integration_backends.native_prediction: stats::predict AveragedPredict on the original response scale
integration_backends.common_result: consensus_mean over predictor-block native variates; common loadings, variance and selected contain predictor blocks only

cli_registration.note: Sol registered mixomics_block_spls after the repair. The factory stays internal.

shared_changes_for_sol.change: Add 'mixomics_block_spls' to triomics_integration_backend_names() and add a dispatch branch in triomics_integration_backend(method) that returns triomics_block_spls_backend().
shared_changes_for_sol.reason: Without it the public evaluate_pipeline and the stage C CLI refuse the method with C_SCORE_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.

no_change_required_in: R/cli.R: the request fields are consumed through schema names (outcome -> response block, design_matrix -> design, n_components -> ncomp); keepX may be one count per block, recycled across candidates.
R/evaluation.R: triomics_evaluation_core is called with the packet adapter directly by the tests.
DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, renv.lock: no new export or dependency.
tests_that_change_when_registered: tests/testthat/test-C-04.R 'C-04 registration boundary' asserts the public registry refuses mixomics_block_spls until this registration is applied; update that expectation when applying the change.
known_gaps: The continuous outcome is the synthetic column score in inst/examples/data/c04/metadata.tsv. The shared independent metadata was not given a response column.
